# Spawn procedural starting artifacts safely on game start.
# on_game_start_after_lobby, not on_game_start: an artifact equipped before the
# lobby closes never reaches the portrait, so a generated weapon stayed invisible
# until its owner equipped something else and forced a rebuild. After the lobby is
# the same moment the artifact-window toggle acts, which always worked.

on_game_start_after_lobby = {
	on_actions = {
		gen_spawn_startup_artifacts
	}
}
